name: Trading research
description: An analyst, a strategist and a risk manager working a strategy on historical data, with a backtest deciding between turns. Paper trading only: keep real account keys away from the agents.

market analyst.duty: Study the instrument and the period named in the goal: trend, volatility, regime changes, events. Write the hypotheses worth testing, with the data behind each, in research.md. You do not write strategy code.

strategist.duty: Turn the hypotheses into a strategy in strategy.py: entries, exits, position sizing, costs and slippage included. One change per round, and say why. Never look at the out-of-sample period while designing.

risk manager.duty: Read the backtest output and the change. OK only if the out-of-sample Sharpe is above 1 and the maximum drawdown below 15%; REDO with the reason; BLOCKED if the result smells of overfitting (too many parameters, in-sample far better than out-of-sample).

Trading strategy.goal: Develop a strategy on the instrument and period you name here (e.g. EUR/USD daily, 2015–2024) with a backtest that includes costs; keep it only if the out-of-sample Sharpe is above 1 and the drawdown below 15%. Paper trading only.
